# Bartender Currently a very simple job. Rarely people come for drinks, and often they'll hop the counter anyways for them. That said, this just gives you more times to do your [textlink="Objectives" link="OrganizationsAndSecretIdentities"].
Drinks can be dispensed or found in a few places if you want to try whip something up:
Given you have freedom much like an [color=#9fed58]Assistant[/color], you are free to use you accesses, abilities, and Double Barrel however you think you can to best help your team. Beanbag rounds aren't incredible in combat, but if you manage to get your hands on some real ammunition than it can pack quite a punch.
